description: Take a match off the venue call screen (needs manage_code). Pass a court to clear only that court's screen — the other courts keep showing their matches. Clearing EVERY court's screen at once requires the explicit all=true flag; a call with neither a court nor all=true is refused, so a forgotten court can never wipe all screens by accident. A cleared screen falls back to the console calling queue board, or to the standby face when the queue is empty. Safe to call when nothing is on screen — it simply reports that. Does not touch the calling queue.

all.description: Set true to clear EVERY court's screen at once. Deliberately explicit — there is no default clear-all.

court.description: Clear only this court's screen. Required unless all=true.

name: screen_clear
